items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: I remember Bus when we were young kids going along and I would follow Bus all over town

ctx.x: Many people thought they were brothers too, you know.

Yeah, but this was what their kinship was. He was Bus's uncle but they were very close. I remember Bus when we were young kids going along and I would follow Bus all over town because Bus was one of the few guys in the gang who could walk on his hands. He was great and adept at anything he would do. He could -- he was a good

tap dancer, a beautiful tap dancer. He could have made his living that way. He played piano, which he played beautifully, which when he died he was still doing a single on piano. He played, of course, with Benny's band but before I got into that part of it, I would like to go back to the time when I knew Benny when I was a kid.
